description: Find the hidden enemy camp (three spearmen north-east or south-west of the base) and destroy it by turn 1800.

objective.success: Player 2 owns no units at a decision boundary by turn 1800.
objective.public: An enemy camp of a few soldiers waits somewhere about 120 meters north-east or south-west of your civic centre. Find it and destroy every enemy unit before turn 1800. Your soldiers must be able to see a target to attack it.
